run_grammar_constrained_generation: run the script to generate grammar-constrained text from a causal language model using an EBNF grammar file
run_unconstrained_vs_constrained_compari: run the script to compare unconstrained and grammar-constrained model outputs side by side
parse_args_model_device: parse command-line arguments to configure the model ID and target device for inference
load_model_and_grammar: load a pretrained causal language model and an EBNF grammar for constrained generation
validate_constrained_output: validate that constrained generation output matches the EBNF grammar using StringRecognizer
